title: Frontend shell: auth, API client, routing, theming, sidebar/topbar/footer, tenant switcher
objective: Deliver the authenticated application shell every screen lives in: OIDC login, API client layer, permission-gated navigation, tenant switcher, light/dark theming from UI-standards tokens, and shared UI primitives (spec FR-52, §10, UI Standards).
scope: OIDC (code+PKCE) via oidc-client-ts: login redirect, silent renew, in-memory tokens, sign-out
ApiClient: bearer token, X-Tenant-Id from session slice, problem+json error normalization, 401/403 handling
Redux slices: session (user, memberships, permissionsByTenant, activeTenantId), dashboardFilters (sessionStorage persisted), alertsBadge

AppShell: Sidebar (nav config, permission gates, active pill, Alerts badge slot), TopBar (title, search placeholder slot, bell, help, Export slot, + New Lead), Footer (currency line from tenant settings, data timestamp slot), UserCard (initials avatar, name, role line, menu: profile, theme toggle, sign out), TenantSwitcher (visible when >1 membership or view-any-tenant)
Design tokens: CSS custom properties for all --qiq-* tokens (light/dark) from QuoteIQ_UI_Standards.md; theme persisted via PUT /me/preferences

Route skeleton for all spec §10.1 routes with route-level permission guards, NotFound/Forbidden pages, toast system, Loading/Empty/ErrorBanner primitives, unsaved-changes prompt hook (useUnsavedChanges)
implementation_details: src/ui/src/auth/oidc.ts configuring oidc-client-ts UserManager against realm quoteiq, client quoteiq-ui; AuthProvider component gating the router; post-login: GET /me, set activeTenantId = lastTenantId ?? first membership, navigate to default screen (FR-04)
src/ui/src/api/client.ts: typed fetch wrapper apiGet/apiPost/apiPut with ProblemDetails -> NormalizedError {status, title, fieldErrors[]}; attaches X-Tenant-Id except for /tenants, /global, /me
src/ui/src/app/slices/sessionSlice.ts with selectors selectHasPermission(code), selectActiveTenant; switching tenant: set header source, PUT /me/preferences, invalidate RTK Query cache
src/ui/src/theme/tokens.css defining §3 UI-standards palette per theme; data-theme attribute on <html>; ThemeToggle in UserCard

src/ui/src/components/shell/*.tsx: Sidebar nav array [{path,label,icon,permission?,badge?}] rendering standard sections then separator then admin sections (Settings, User Manager, Tenant Manager) per PRD 12.1
Router: createBrowserRouter with all routes from spec §10.1 as lazy stubs; RouteGuard checks permission and renders Forbidden
Shared primitives: Toast (success/error), SkeletonTable, EmptyState {icon,message,actions}, ErrorBanner with retry, ConfirmDialog base, StatusChip placeholder (finalized T-031)

e2e: login.spec.ts: unauthenticated visit redirects to Keycloak login; valid credentials land on last-active tenant default screen
shell.spec.ts: sidebar hides admin entries for a user without admin permissions; tenant switcher switches context and footer currency updates; theme toggle persists across reload
logout.spec.ts: sign-out returns to login; deep link while unauthenticated redirects to login

findings.description: Shell e2e specs fail under the committed LOCAL worker default. playwright.config.ts uses workers: process.env['CI'] ? 1 : undefined, so a plain local `npx playwright test` runs unbounded workers; parallel logins as the 3 shared Keycloak personas trip bruteForceProtected -> 'Invalid username or password' (evaluator reproduced: 2 failed / 4 skipped; re-seed + --workers=1 -> 11/11). The suite is green only in CI or with explicit --workers=1.
findings.recommendation: Set workers: 1 unconditionally for this suite (or provision per-worker/per-test Keycloak accounts) so `npx playwright test` is green without relying on the CI env var.
findings.resolution: Verified fix iteration 2 (evaluator independent audit). playwright.config.ts:21 now sets workers: 1 unconditionally (documented rationale), so a plain `npx playwright test` no longer trips Keycloak bruteForceProtected on the shared personas. Evaluator independently ran npx playwright test (no CI env) -> 12 passed + 9 fixme-skipped.

findings.description: Footer display currency is wrong for tenant members lacking business_rules.view, violating AC-074 (tenant display currency used everywhere for all members). useTenantCurrency catches the 403 from GET /settings/business-rules and falls back to hard-coded BWP, so a non-admin member of a non-BWP tenant (e.g. the ZAR Tenant B) sees 'All amounts in BWP'. Currently masked in the seed only because the non-admin persona e2e-rm lives in the BWP tenant, and the switch-updates-currency e2e only exercises e2e-internal (who holds the permission), so the non-privileged path is untested.
findings.evidence: src/ui/src/components/shell/useTenantCurrency.ts:31-35 (catch 403 -> BWP fallback); GET /settings/business-rules requires business_rules.view; shell.spec.ts currency assertion uses the privileged persona only.
findings.recommendation: ORCHESTRATOR DECISION: expose the tenant display currency to ALL tenant members via the GET /me contract (add currencyCode, and currencySymbol if readily available, to each membership entry in GET /me, sourced from tenant_settings created by T-010). Source the footer currency from the session (from /me) and REMOVE the GET /settings/business-rules dependency + the 403->BWP degrade in useTenantCurrency. Add an e2e asserting a non-admin member of a non-BWP tenant sees the correct currency code. This is a members-accessible, spec-aligned contract extension (not a product ambiguity): AC-074 requires the display currency for all members, so it must not sit behind a Settings-tab permission.
findings.resolution: Verified fix iteration 2 (evaluator independent audit incl. isolation review + live e2e). Backend: GET /me MembershipDto carries CurrencyCode + CurrencySymbol per membership (GetMeQueryHandler.cs:54-59) from the real tenant_settings columns (T-010, no invented symbol table). LEFT-join/IgnoreQueryFilters/BWP-fallback confirmed correct and isolation-safe: tenant_settings joined ON ut.TenantId==s.TenantId while ut is confined to WHERE UserId==userId (settings pulled only for the caller's own tenants; unique(tenant_id) prevents fan-out); IgnoreQueryFilters matches the pre-existing user_tenants/tenants bypass since /me has no ambient tenant; LEFT join deliberate so a provisioning-gap missing settings row does not drop a membership and break SetMePreferences authz; BWP fallback fires ONLY on a genuinely missing settings row (s!=null ? s.CurrencyCode : 'BWP'), never a permission degrade. GetMeTests seeds BWP Tenant A + ZAR/R Tenant B and asserts membershipB with NO permission (explicit DoesNotContain BusinessRules.View) still returns CurrencyCode=ZAR/Symbol=R (real Postgres+Keycloak, no mocks). Frontend: useTenantCurrency rewritten to selectActiveTenantCurrency from session; GET /settings/business-rules call + 403->BWP degrade fully removed from the shell (businessRules.ts left unused, reserved T-016); AuthProvider maps fields on login; tenant-switch updates currency from the newly active membership with no settings refetch; /me X-Tenant-Id exemption intact. E2E: persona e2e-rm-b (single ZAR Tenant-B membership, no business_rules.view) seeded idempotently; shell.spec.ts:43-51 asserts its footer reads ZAR and NOT BWP -- a genuine regression lock (would have degraded to BWP under the old code). No regression to iteration-1 security/ACs/tests; no assertion weakened; no any introduced.

Evaluation (iteration 1/10): VERDICT NEEDS_FIXES. Completeness: all 8 ACs mapped and confirmed (AC-001/002/004/009/016/051/070/074) EXCEPT the non-privileged footer-currency path; router covers every spec 10.1 route (line-by-line verified) + OIDC callbacks; tokens.css matches UI Standards section 3 exactly (none invented). Evaluator INDEPENDENTLY ran (not blocked by env): typecheck clean, vitest 26/26, backend 220/220, and brought up the FULL live stack (compose Keycloak+PG+Vault+MinIO + API on :5080 with VAULT_TOKEN + Local profile + Vite :5173 + seed) and executed all 11 Playwright specs -> 11/11 with --workers=1. Tests meaningful/non-tautological (both-direction Sidebar gating, ApiClient exemption matrix + ProblemDetails + 401, TenantSwitcher truth table; e2e drive the real code+PKCE flow). Ambiguity adjudication: (a) UserCard role-line=tenant-name ACCEPTABLE (/me has no role field; note future /me extension), (c) /auth/callback+/auth/silent-renew ACCEPTABLE (required OIDC handlers). BLOCKING: F-046 (major, AC-074) footer currency wrong for members lacking business_rules.view (useTenantCurrency 403->hard-coded BWP; non-admin member of a non-BWP tenant sees wrong currency; non-privileged path untested, masked because e2e-rm lives in BWP tenant and the currency e2e uses only the privileged persona); F-045 (minor) playwright workers not pinned to 1 for local runs -> bruteForceProtected lockout on shared personas. iteration_count 1 < 10 so NEEDS_FIXES.
